ShapeEngine
Table of Contents

Class ShapeInput

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides static access to input devices (keyboard, mouse, gamepads) and input state queries. Handles device switching, input state retrieval, and device change events.

CurrentInputActionDeviceType

Current InputAction based device type detected by ActiveInputActionTreeGroup. The first non-None InputDeviceType detected during the update of the ActiveInputActionTreeGroup is used.

public static InputDeviceType CurrentInputActionDeviceType { get; }

Property Value

InputDeviceType

Remarks

For an InputActions IInputTypes InputDeviceType to be considered the following conditions must be met:

  • The InputAction must be part of an InputActionTree within the ActiveInputActionTreeGroup.
  • The InputAction must be active.
  • The IInputType's InputState must be down.
  • The IInputType must not be blocked (when BlocksInput is true).

Gets the current input device type in use.

Property Value

bool

Locked

Indicates if the input system is currently locked. When set to true, InputActions and other input requests will only be processed if they have the AllAccessTag or their access tag is contained in the lock whitelist. All InputActions and input request with an access tag contained in the lock blacklist will not be processed.

public static bool Locked { get; }

Property Value

bool

NextAccessTag

Gets the next available access tag. 1 is reserved for AllAccessTag, 2 is reserved for DefaultAccessTag. Only power of 2 values are used for access tags.

public static uint NextAccessTag { get; }

Property Value

uint

ApplyInputDeviceChangeSettings(InputDeviceUsageDetectionSettings)

Applies the InputDeviceUsageDetectionSettings to all currently active input devices.

public static void ApplyInputDeviceChangeSettings(InputDeviceUsageDetectionSettings settings)

Parameters

settings InputDeviceUsageDetectionSettings

The new InputDeviceUsageDetectionSettings to apply.

Remarks

Settings are applied to ActiveMouseDevice, ActiveKeyboardDevice, and ActiveGamepadDeviceManager that applies the settings to all GamepadDevices.

ChangeActiveGamepadDeviceManager(GamepadDeviceManager)

Changes the active GamepadDeviceManager.

public static bool ChangeActiveGamepadDeviceManager(GamepadDeviceManager deviceManager)

Parameters

deviceManager GamepadDeviceManager

The new GamepadDeviceManager to set as active.

Returns

bool

True if the device manager was changed; otherwise, false.

Remarks

This will call Deactivate() on the current active GamepadDeviceManager and it will call Activate() on the new GamepadDeviceManager. This will change the active state of both the current and the new GamepadDeviceManager. This will also deactivate all GamepadDevices in the current GamepadDeviceManager and activate all GamepadDevices in the new GamepadDeviceManager.

ChangeActiveKeyboardDevice(KeyboardDevice)

public static bool ChangeActiveKeyboardDevice(KeyboardDevice device)

device KeyboardDevice

Returns

Remarks

This will call Deactivate() on the current active KeyboardDevice and it will call Activate() on the new KeyboardDevice. This will change the active state of both the current and the new KeyboardDevice.

Determines if the specified access tag has access. AllAccessTag always returns true (has access).

  • If tag is contained in the current blacklist, this function will return false (no access).
  • If tag is not contained in the current blacklist and tag is contained in the current whitelist, or the current whitelist is empty, this function will return true (has access).
public static bool HasAccess(uint tag)

Parameters

tag uint

The access tag to check.

Returns

bool

True if access is granted; otherwise, false.

IsInputAvailable(uint)

Determines if input is available for the specified access tag. Always returns true if Locked is false. Otherwise returns HasAccess(uint) with the tag parameter. 

public static bool IsInputAvailable(uint tag)

tag uint

Lock()

Locks the input system, clearing all whitelists and blacklists. Only InputActions and input requests with AllAccessTag will be processed. 

public static void Lock()

Lock(BitFlag, BitFlag)

Locks the input system with a specific whitelist and blacklist. All InputActions and other input requests with a tag contained in the whitelist or with the AllAccessTag will be processed. All InputActions and other input requests with a tag contained in the blacklist will not be processed.
